follow_up.question: What if costs may be negative?
follow_up.reference: Dijkstra finalisation is no longer generally valid. An acyclic graph still permits topological relaxation, while Bellman-Ford handles more general graphs.

follow_up.question: What simpler method works for equal link costs?
follow_up.reference: Breadth-first search minimises link count. With a common positive cost, it also minimises total cost.
